description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Notify the Collective Agreement entered into between Kurunegala Plantation Limiited and Inter Company Employees Union (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of a Collective Agreement under the Industrial Disputes Act, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It establishes legal terms and conditions of employment between an employer and a union, making it a legal/regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
